description: Which components may compose with which. Checked by VALIDATE_COMPOSITION.

mustNotInclude: ui:tooltip as the only warning surface
More than one primary button per action region
Dead-end state with no recovery action
Auto-applied change with no human confirmation step

structuralConstraints.rule: Compound component parts must render inside their root. SheetContent requires Sheet; SelectItem requires SelectContent; CardTitle belongs in CardHeader.
One primary-variant button per action region.
Do not nest ui:dialog inside ui:dialog or ui:sheet. Use one overlay and change its content.
Do not place a button or link inside another interactive trigger (DropdownMenuTrigger, TooltipTrigger, etc.) without asChild.
Any ai:* body or output component must be preceded by an attribution affordance in the same region (ai:ai-message-header or ai:ai-avatar).
